title: GlanceFold: compact tile collapse + drag-reorder visual spec & accessibility redlines
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create final visual specification, redlines, and handoff notes for the new GlanceFold compact metric tiles pattern: collapsible cards that conserve vertical space on dashboard rollouts and expose quick actions on drag/reorder or keyboard focus. Deliverables: annotated Figma frames, motion tokens, contrast adjustments, copy bits for collapsed state, and a developer checklist for keyboard/ARIA implementation.
comments: 2025-11-03 - Maya Patel: Initial concept review with PM/Eng. PM requested an explicit pin state so important tiles can remain expanded across sessions (asked for telemetry hooks). Engineering flagged potential perf impact for live metric streaming when many tiles are expanded.

2025-11-04 - Tom Rivera (PM): Stakeholder note - prioritize accessibility keyboard flows and a11y testing; product prefers a single global toggle for 'preserve expansion' in settings instead of per-tile persisted state. Added to product constraints.

2025-11-05 - Leena Gupta (Frontend Eng): Implementation note - drag-to-reorder must degrade to a menu-based reorder for touch+keyboard; provided link to prototype repo with reorder utility (github.com/redwood-inference/console-proto#pr-4287).

2025-11-06 - Alex Chen (Design Ops): Reviewed contrast ratios. Requested darker separators and a 7:1 ratio for collapsed title text against background in compact density. Attached redline PDF in Drive.

2025-11-07 - Jordan Lee (Assignee): Updated Figma with new motion durations (80ms entry, 120ms exit), added reduced-motion variants. Uploaded annotated frames to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/glancefold-specs
2025-11-08 - Security & Compliance: Note - ensure analytics opt-out respects PII rules when persisting pinned state. Recommend using ephemeral local storage flag + server opt-in.
decisions: Use a single chevron affordance for collapse/expand with explicit ARIA label 'Expand tile details' and 'Collapse tile details'
Implement per-session expansion persistence by default; product will evaluate a global 'preserve expansion' setting in a later release.
Drag-to-reorder primary for pointer users; provide keyboard reorder controls (Move up / Move down) in the tile context menu for a11y compliance.
Motion durations set to 80ms (enter) / 120ms (exit) with spring easing; include a reduced-motion variant that disables motion and uses immediate height swap.
Contrast adjustments: collapsed title text minimum 7:1, secondary meta text minimum 4.5:1. Separators to use neutral-700 token.

Engineering: spike to validate streaming perf with 50 concurrent expanded tiles (Leena) - due 2025-11-13
Product: confirm retention model for pinned tiles and telemetry schema (Tom) - due 2025-11-12
DesignOps: prepare handoff bundle (Figma frames + motion tokens + a11y checklist) and upload to the shared drive (Alex) - due 2025-11-10

qa_tasks: Verify collapsed tile shows accessible label and receives focus via Tab order
Test keyboard-based reorder flows (context menu -> Move up / Move down) across dense and compact density settings
Reduced-motion: confirm no layout shift animations and immediate height changes when OS prefers reduced motion
Contrast checks for all text states (collapsed, expanded, hover) using axe/pa11y
Telemetry: simulate 1k users toggling pin state to ensure opt-out respects PII filters
accessibility_considerations: Keyboard-first interactions for reorder/collapse, ARIA-expanded states on the chevron button, explicit focus ring for compact density, focus order stable during drag fallback. Reduced-motion variant and high-contrast tokens required. Provide aria-live region updates for metric value changes when tiles are expanded.
